criteria.deficiency: The column does not freeze a task's elapsed time when the task completes, unlike the reference, which records finished_time at completion and renders that value. Nothing in the original code calls stop_task on completion or on Progress exit, so the value never freezes unless the caller does it manually. This is a user-visible behavioral gap for the feature. The rest of the feature (style, class name, column rendering while running) is correct.
